military.backstory.oathbreakerJarl: Swore an oath to a jarl and broke it over a matter never spoken of. Has sold a sword ever since and keeps no friends for long.
military.backstory.feudOutlaw: Outlawed at the Thing after a blood-feud went too far. Cannot go home, and fights as if there were nothing left to lose.
military.backstory.shipwreckSurvivor: The only one to walk out of the surf when a trading ship broke on the skerries. Owes the sea a life and knows it.
military.backstory.harbourGuard: Kept the harbour watch of a busy market town for years, until a new reeve brought in his own kin. Knows ships, tolls and liars.
military.backstory.riverRower: Rowed the long rivers to the east and dragged boats over the portages. Strong in the back, patient, and quiet about what was seen there.
military.backstory.landlessYounger: A younger child of a good family, with an elder sibling holding the farm. Wants land, a name and a reason to be remembered.
military.backstory.fallenHouse: The last of a house that lost its hall to fire and its lands to a neighbour. Carries the old pride like a heavy cloak.
military.backstory.whalerCrew: Hunted whales and seals in the cold northern waters. Steady with a spear, and unbothered by blood or weather.
military.backstory.caravanGuard: Guarded traders on the overland roads of the south and learned a little of every tongue spoken at a market.
military.backstory.cloisterRunaway: Raised behind cloister walls and taught letters there, then ran away to see the world. Still counts and writes better than any steward.
military.backstory.oldHuscarl: Served a dead lord's hearth-troop for twenty winters. Grey now, scarred and slow to laugh, but the shield arm has not forgotten.
military.backstory.returnedHostage: Spent a childhood as a hostage at a foreign court and came home a stranger. Speaks well, trusts no one and watches everything.
military.unitInfo.bondi: Free farmers with spear and shield. Cheap, steady in a shield wall, good against horsemen.
military.unitInfo.huscarls: Sworn household warriors. Heavy shields and the best kit the realm can give. Needs a Hall of the second tier.
military.unitInfo.archers: Hunters with bows. Volleys from range; fire arrows when there is pitch.
military.unitInfo.skirmishers: Light fighters with throwing axes and javelins that break up shield walls.
military.unitInfo.berserkers: Warriors who fight in a battle-fury. Few will follow a house that has not earned the songs and kept the old faith.
military.unitInfo.wolfcoats: Scouts in wolf pelts who move unseen until they strike. No more than twenty-five to a squad.
military.unitInfo.fjordWallHuscarls: Skarn huscarls whose shield wall is famous along the fjords.
military.unitInfo.elkBowArchers: Hvarn archers with long elk-horn bows; they shoot further and truer.
military.unitInfo.strandRiders: Eyjar riders on small sturdy horses. Fast along the strand, but they will not go into buildings.
